products.product_description: Jolly Rancher product is hard candies, individually wrapped in flexible plastic wrap, and package in plastic bag. Net weight 2 oz or 4.5 oz. UPC on the 4.5 oz. bag: 7 09972 80101 0. The label of the retail bag is read in parts: INGREDIENTS: CORN SYRUP, SUGAR, CONTAINS 2% OR LESS OF, MALIC ACID, NATURAL AND ARTIFICIAL FLAVOR, ARTIFICIAL COLOR (RED 40, BLUE 3, YELLOW 5, YELLOW 6), SULFUR DIOXIDE, TO MAINTAIN FRESHNESS *** MAY CONTAIN: PEANUTS***SOY*** Product of USA *** Werner Gourmet Meat Snacks Inc. Tillamook, OR 97141 *** www.wernerjerky.com ***.
products.product_quantity: 2076 cases (12/2 oz. packages per case) and 7199 cases (6/4.5 oz. packages per case)
